title: Ousama Game
overview: In Ousama Game the player challenges various young women to simple games, and if the girl loses they must do whatever the player asks. There are three different mini-games, selected at random by a roulette: a rock-paper-scissors-style game where the losing player must react quickly to block an attack; a flags-style game where the player must push buttons according to an announcer's instructions; and a simple action game where the player must climb a bamboo shoot while avoiding falling objects. Upon winning a game, the player can select from a list of actions they can force the girl to do, such as "go for a swim" or "take a shower", and watch a video clip of them doing as ordered. There are eight girls to challenge, each of whom has numerous different situations and video clips to see.
